html_title: Tseko · Research engineer, AI in medicine
meta_description: Tsvetan R. Yordanov (Tseko) is a research engineer at Amsterdam UMC, working on LLMs and other AI for primary care and on the infrastructure research runs on.
level_title: One level per year since my first PC
lede: Working at the intersection of AI and clinical medicine.
photo_alt: Tseko as a kid in 2001, in a yellow T-shirt and cap, turning round from the desk with the first PC and its CRT monitor.
about_p1: At Amsterdam UMC’s Department of General Practice I explore how LLMs and other modern AI can help primary care, and, as an infrastructure engineer, help decide how its databases and systems fit together. I also build secure data pipelines for the Netherlands Heart Registration.
about_p2: Before that: a PhD on robust validation of clinical prediction models, and a decade of software engineering. I like using curiosity to improve everyday life, one step at a time.
fl_desc: Four hospitals each train on their own patients. Only model updates travel to a shared model in the middle, which is merged and sent back. Patient data never leaves its hospital.
fl_legend: patient data never leaves its hospital
fl_caption: Federated learning, as in my TAVI work.
motto: Rather than listing frameworks and languages, I prefer to choose the right instrument for the task at hand.
music_text: Electronic music, made for fun, played mostly to myself.
quote: Storytelling reveals meaning without committing the error of defining it.
act1_p: School kept getting in the way of an MMORPG, so I wrote a bot to play while I sat in class. It levelled up faster than I did, and taught me how computers work.
sq_text: How a computer works, in eight zoom levels.
act2_p: Contests in C, where code has to be right and fast.
act3_p: The same puzzles, with a pencil.
act4_p: Computing science, maths and astronomy in Glasgow. First paper at SIGIR 2014.
map_title: Map of the road so far
map_desc: An old-style map of Europe with a route from Pleven in Bulgaria to Glasgow in Scotland, a detour to Valencia in Spain, and on to Amsterdam in the Netherlands.
stop_glasgow: University, then JPMorgan Chase. Seven years, several umbrellas.
stop_valencia: A DevOps detour, with better weather.
